name: Vanndar Stormpike
summary: At Dun Baldar, Vanndar Stormpike leads the Stormpike Expedition through the frozen peaks of Alterac Valley. He seeks ancient relics and raw resources while waging war against the Frostwolf orcs.

sections.title: Lord of Dun Baldar
sections.body: Vanndar Stormpike leads the dwarven excavation in Alterac Valley as a veteran mountain king of Ironforge. After the Third War, he marched the Stormpike Guard into the northern mountains in search of hidden mineral riches and long-lost titan artifacts. Dun Baldar became his fortified base. He claims the valley as ancestral ground and rightful Alliance territory, and directs its outposts, bunkers, and frontline advances. Under Vanndar's command, retreat is never sounded.

sections.title: War for the Frozen Pass
sections.body: Vanndar's mining and prospecting reached into the Frostwolf clan's home, and a brutal mountain war began. The orcs demanded his withdrawal, but he refused to yield an inch. He vowed that Alterac Valley would belong to the dwarves. From his throne room deep within Dun Baldar, Vanndar oversees the defense against Frostwolf incursions, with marshals and bodyguards at his side. He also sends Alliance champions to break enemy lines and claim the valley.

faq.answer: Vanndar Stormpike commands the Stormpike Expedition as a dwarf mountain king. From Dun Baldar, he leads the Alliance war effort in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Why is Vanndar fighting in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: Vanndar brought the Stormpike Expedition to Alterac Valley in search of ancient relics and natural resources. His refusal to abandon those claims drew the dwarves into bloody conflict with the native Frostwolf orcs.
Vanndar commands his forces from Dun Baldar, a stronghold in northern Alterac Valley. Dwarven bunkers, marshals, and elite guards protect it.
Vanndar's main enemy is Drek'Thar, chieftain and elder shaman of the Frostwolf clan. Drek'Thar seeks to drive the dwarven interlopers from the Frostwolves' ancestral homeland.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you can see Vanndar's indomitable Mountain King spirit in his fight to claim ancient heritage and honor the Explorer's Guild.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Vanndar as the leading commander on the Alterac front. He holds the northern ramparts and pushes Alliance territory into the wild mountains.
